name: 40047 · Mt Washington, KY
findings: ZIP 40047 (Mt Washington) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40047 (Mt Washington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
